Titan Trade Alerts
About Privacy

Personal notification utility

Trading-system alerts.
Through your own Gmail.

Titan Trade Alerts sends operational notifications from a locally run trading system to the destination its owner approves.

It is maintained by Shian Harper for personal use. It is not a public email service, brokerage, or investment-advice service.

What the app does

After separate local setup and Google authorization, the notification worker can send alerts about fills, protection status, exits, risk controls, system failures, and explicitly authorized tests.

Messages may contain trading information such as a symbol, quantity, event status, or the reason an alert was raised. Email delivery may be delayed or fail; an email is not a substitute for checking the broker.

What happens when you connect

You review the Google account and requested permission in your system browser. The local setup flow requests only gmail.send, so the app can send email on your behalf. It does not request permission to read your inbox, manage drafts, delete messages, or access Drive or Contacts.

The app uses the sender and recipient configured by its owner. This recipient restriction is enforced by Titan's configuration, not by Google's send-email permission.
